processingNote: Asset Optimization Wave 2 (2026-08-18): texture-downscale-only derivative. The embedded baseColorTexture (4096x2048 px) exceeded the project's 2048px-longest-edge texture budget, so it was downscaled to 2048x1024 px (max 2048 on the longest edge, aspect ratio preserved, never upscaled) using `gltf-transform resize --width 2048 --height 2048` (Lanczos3 filtering, `@gltf-transform/cli` 4.4.2). This is a pure texture operation — mesh geometry, UVs, vertex count, triangle count, node/scene structure, and material assignment are byte-for-byte identical to the source (verified via `gltf-transform inspect`: vertex and triangle counts match exactly, only the image bytes and reported texture resolution changed). No license or attribution facts changed from the original — this derivative carries forward the exact same provenance as enceladus.glb, listed above. Original file preserved unmodified alongside this derivative; nothing was deleted or overwritten.
